notes.title: Graphics and Environment Update Now Live
notes.notes: [p]The latest update to 🌿 Greenhouse 🌿 is here. This patch contains:[/p][p]- Improved lighting[/p][p]- Improved ghost look (as requested by a few people)[/p][p]- Improved textures for the game character. (Look down at your feet!) 🦶🦶[/p][p]- Updated content at the start of the game[/p][p]- Smoother Perspective Puzzles[/p]

[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45199226/a4511776d60891f91c1abb5e99801d2ec0389c25.jpg[/img][/td]
[td]You’ve felt the pull and broken into the compound. But what is this place… Why are you there? Do you remember the place, or does it remember you?
                    
[i]Greenhouse[/i] is a psychological mystery where the story is uncovered through environmental clues and sometimes unsettling sixth sense visions.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]In this latest demo update, we’ve added some more breadcrumbs to draw you deeper into the world without spoiling what lies ahead.
                    
The demo is just the beginning. The full story and final twist that ties it all together is awaiting you in the full game.[/td]
